items.title: Gemini app on Mac gets computer use that runs in a background window while you keep working
items.summary: Gemini can now click, scroll and type across folders, apps and the web in an isolated background window on Mac, shown turning a sketch into a rigged 3D model in Blender. Rolling out in the US in English to Google AI Plus, Pro and Ultra subscribers.

doubt.pushback: Availability is limited to US English paid tiers and replies report nothing tested yet.

reception.summary: Replies were mostly jokes, laptop heat worries and questions whether it beats Claude or Codex computer use; nobody reports having tried it.

items.title: TensorFold 1.3.0 lifts GLM-5.3-Flash from 83.8 to 104.1 tok/s on two RTX PRO 6000 Blackwells
items.summary: The local inference server release reports about 24% faster decode on CUDA at TP=2 with NVFP4 experts and identical output bits in that test, plus about 1.5x faster prompt attention for DeepSeek-V4.1 on Metal and about 3 GiB less page cache after loading NVFP4 exports.

items.title: FastVideo open-sources Dreamverse Harness for agent-run video production on local DGX Sparks or cloud
items.summary: An open harness that lets any agent work through a whole film project from script to final cut, with its own compute management, running fully local on up to four DGX Sparks or through cloud providers.

items.title: Nace AI Drex Router picks the model and reasoning effort for each agent step, 87.6% vs 86.4% for a rival router
items.summary: A small routing model chooses which LLM or SLM and how much reasoning effort to use per step; the vendor reports 87.6% accuracy against 86.4% for Jev Router and a cost test over 306 prompts. Access is through a sign-in console.

doubt.pushback: Numbers are vendor-reported and the post carries a sign-up credit promotion.

items.title: OpenAI GPT-Live-1.1 is in the API with steadier accents across languages and a standby option for long sessions
items.summary: The live voice model update speaks with more consistent accents, follows instructions better and adds an idle standby mode that lowers cost for long-running sessions.

items.title: Bespoke Labs Multi Agent Coordination Bench: 12 long-horizon tasks show frontier agents coordinate poorly
items.summary: A benchmark of twelve natively multi-agent tasks built on Harbor. Eight agents beat one, but the authors say the gain comes from agent count, not coordination, and only Opus showed signs of a coordination gain among three frontier models.

items.title: Letta FrontierMemory leaderboard: GPT-6.2 Astra scores 64.4% on agent learning, up from 44.4% for GPT-6 Astra
items.summary: Letta's memory benchmark for continual learning in agents reports GPT-6.2 Astra well ahead of its predecessor, while GPT-6.2 Sol stays level with earlier generations. The full leaderboard is on the project site.

doubt.pushback: Post was minutes old with no reception yet; method is only on the linked leaderboard.
